# Observability and Auditability Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that audit, logging, metrics, and measurement requirements are complete and honestly labelled
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Audit Evidence

- [ ] CHK001 - Is a run or correlation identifier required across logs, metrics, traces, audit events, and artifacts, with a record lacking it defined as a failure? [Completeness, Spec NFR-005, Constitution IX] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does each audit event require actor type, action, timestamp, affected subject, result, and reason? [Measurability, Spec FR-130, Audit schema] [M, G0] {Detects: incomplete-audit-evidence}
- [ ] CHK003 - Is every state transition, decision, approval, retry, failure, replan, and terminal outcome required to be audited? [Coverage, Spec FR-130] [M, G0] {Detects: incomplete-audit-evidence}
- [ ] CHK004 - Is audit immutability defined (no edit or delete by workflow actors, mechanism, verification)? [Completeness, Spec FR-130 NAC, ADR-006] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is "a run can be reconstructed from the audit record alone" defined as an acceptance test? [Measurability, Spec FR-130 AC, US-5] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are application-plane audit events (such as analytics capture failure) defined with fields and retention? [Coverage, Spec FR-014, Data Model §2.2] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is audit chain verification defined with its failure effect (safe-stop, readiness)? [Coverage, Orchestration SS-5, ADR-006] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is audit retention consistent with analytics retention (audit kept for the prototype, events 30 days)? [Consistency, Spec ASM-016, POL-RET-001] [M, G0]

## Logs, Metrics, and Measurement

- [ ] CHK009 - Are log content rules defined (no secrets, URLs, addresses), with redaction and a detection? [Coverage, Spec FR-013, ADR-008] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is each required metric defined by name, labels, and plane, with no sensitive labels? [Completeness, Observability §3] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are success rate, failure rate, retry frequency, compensation frequency, and end-to-end latency defined with formulas and populations? [Clarity, Observability §4] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is MTTR defined with formula, denominator rule, timestamps, mechanism, status, population, exclusions, and limitations, with unrecovered failures excluded and reported separately? [Completeness, ADR-008, Observability §5] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is MTTR traceable to a specification requirement (FR-131 does not name it)? [Gap, Spec FR-131] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK014 - Must measurement reports label demonstration versus production and carry limitations, so no synthetic figure is presented as production? [Coverage, Spec FR-131 NAC, POL-OBS-004] [M, G0] {Detects: fabricated-results}
- [ ] CHK015 - Are clock kind and synthetic flags required on all durations and failure events? [Coverage, Spec DEC-044, ADR-010] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are measurement exclusions defined and each excluded event listed with a reason? [Clarity, Measurement schema] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are histories (transition, decision, approval, retry, compensation, replanning) each queryable through a defined interface? [Coverage, Observability §1] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the evidence export defined (contents, hashes, mode labels)? [Completeness, Observability §6] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is OpenTelemetry integration labelled backlog? [Coverage, Plan §6.1 BL-02] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
